name: BMP-1
protection: Light armour. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R can damage optics and exposed systems; 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate sides on the lighter variants; any launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Low tracked hull with sharp ribbed wedge nose and flat roof sloping slightly towards the rear
Small conical one-man turret with short 73 mm gun and Malyutka rail above it
6 road wheels per side, return rollers, top hatches over the troop compartment
Two rear doors double as fuel tanks
Low tracked hull with sharp ribbed nose and small conical turret
